text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDB-4783 — APIGW 5xx spike detected in multiple regions. Severity: high. Links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDB-4783

pagerduty: Page delivered to on-call: sam (SRE) :rotating_light:

sam: oncall here, looking. seeing alerts for 502/504 on /v1/infer. starting triage.

maria: metric snapshot: 5xx rate went from ~0.3% -> 6.9% over the last 4m for proxy-edge-host:edge-proxy-2. error mix 502 + upstream 504.

devon: I see a deployment to edge-proxy fleet at 2026-03-17T02:18Z (edge-proxy v3.4.1). Rolling back candidate now.

sam: before rollback — quick smoke: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"input":"hi"}'` -> HTTP/2 502, upstream reset.

joan: recommend partial traffic shift to fallback region while rollback happens. propose 25% -> us-west-dedicated.

sam: enabling routing policy `fallback-on-502` at 25% to us-west-dedicated.

incident-bot: Automatic circuit-breaker engaged on edge-proxy-2 (threshold exceeded: 20% 5xx over 2m).

maria: also observing KV-cache backend timeouts increasing; might be compounding things (cache miss ratio jumped).

devon: rollback triggered: edge-proxy fleet -> v3.4.0. watching as pods drain.

support-bot: Notifying support channel and starting status page draft. Suggested status: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors on the inference API. Some requests may return 502/504. Engineers are actively mitigating."

sam: rolling back completed on edge-proxy-2 and associated ASG. Real-time errors dropping — current 5xx ~0.8%.

maria: running smoke checks across endpoints: `/health` -> 200, `/v1/infer` sample -> 200 and normal latency. Sampling 50 requests: 0 502s.

devon: confirmed upstream NLBs showed connection reset spikes coincident with v3.4.1 rollout. hypothesis: new proxy change increased concurrent conn usage triggering NLB resets.

joan: keeping fallback policy for another 10m while we monitor.

sam: creating short incident ticket for postmortem and timeline. Assigning to leo for postmortem and CL (cc devon, maria).

support-bot: Status page posted and customers notified. Message includes "We will provide an update within 30 minutes."

leo: taking postmortem ownership. saving logs, capture rollout diff, NLB metrics, and proxy config change list.

sam: incident resolved — moving to monitoring state. follow-up action items: revert proxy change (done), add circuit-breaker tuning to deploy playbook, increase NLB connection thresholds for canaries, improve canary metrics alarm.

joan: handing off to morning SREs for follow-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: note for postmortem — add KV-cache alarms and add synthetic checks that hit /v1/infer full path (not just /health).

sam: closing channel for active mitigation. Will update ticket with timeline and action items.
